descriptions.text: The Italian cryptocurrency exchange Altsbit was hacked. As of now, the value of stolen Bitcoin and Ether is about 70,000 U.S. dollars. The website stated that it will be closed after partial refund of client funds.

Altsbit, a recently rebranded Italian exchange, was breached on February 5, 2020, losing $317,000 worth of BTC, ETH, ARRR, VRSC, and KMD held in hot wallets. About half of all user assets were stolen. Only cold wallet balances allowed partial refunds, and the platform ceased operations after the refund window ended. No technical vulnerability or forensic root cause was published. Altsbit stored a majority of user assets in online hot wallets vulnerable to unauthorized access. The exact attack mechanism,whether leaked keys or compromised infrastructure,was not publicly disclosed. Key or infrastructure exposure is inferred from platform and industry reporting.
